requirement: server-side object ownership/permission check exists on every read/write route
architecture_reasoning: Reviewed the full route table in app/dashboard/views.py: every registered view serves a shared, org-wide aggregate with no per-object URL parameter and no user-owned record lookup anywhere in the request path.
call_chain: HTTP request -> auth middleware (session) -> OrdersView.get/post -> Order.objects.get(pk=order_id) -> ownership check -> response
result_reasoning: SEC-001 does not apply: this deployment has no per-object resources addressable by id, so there is no object-level access boundary for an ownership check to apply to.
